title: 望海潮（东南形胜）
titleEn: Watching the Tide: The Splendour of the Southeast
author: 柳永
intro: A thousand-year-old travel poster for Hangzhou: misty willows and painted bridges, a hundred thousand households, the roaring Qiantang tide, West Lake with its osmanthus and lotus, and music on the water day and night.
analysis: 这首词描写北宋时杭州的繁华和美景。上阕写城市。开头三句总写：杭州地处东南，地势优越，是三吴的大都会，自古繁华。接着一层层展开：如烟的柳树，彩绘的小桥，挡风的帘子，翠绿的帷幕，高高低低住着十万户人家。城外，大树环绕着钱塘江的沙堤，汹涌的潮水卷起霜雪一样的白浪，江面宽得望不到边。城里，市场摆满珍珠宝石，家家堆满绫罗绸缎，比赛谁更豪华。下阕写西湖和人：湖山重叠，清秀美丽；秋天桂花飘香，夏天荷花十里。白天笛声悠扬，夜里菱歌飘荡，钓鱼的老人、采莲的姑娘都很快乐。长官带着上千骑兵出游，醉中听乐，欣赏山水。最后说：将来把美景画下来，带回朝廷去夸耀。全词从大到小、由远及近，层次分明。相传金国皇帝读到“三秋桂子，十里荷花”，就动了南下的念头，这虽是传说，却说明这几句多么动人。
analysisEn: This lyric celebrates Hangzhou at the height of the Northern Song — its wealth and its beauty. The first half is the city. Three opening lines sum it up: the best-placed spot in the southeast, the great metropolis of the Wu region, rich since ancient times. Then the details unfold layer by layer: willows soft as mist, painted bridges, curtains against the wind, green drapes, a hundred thousand households of every height. Outside the walls, tall trees ring the sandy dykes of the Qiantang River, whose famous tidal bore rolls in with waves white as frost and snow; the river is so wide it seems to have no far bank. Inside, the markets are full of pearls and gems and every home is stacked with silks, each trying to outshine the others. The second half moves to West Lake and its people: layers of water and peaks, clear and lovely; osmanthus in autumn, lotus for miles in summer; flutes playing on sunny days, water-chestnut songs drifting over the lake at night; old anglers and lotus-picking girls all enjoying themselves. The governor rides out with a thousand horsemen, listens to pipes and drums a little drunk, and admires the misty scenery. One day, the poet says, you’ll paint this and take it back to court to show off. The description is laid out from large to small, far to near, in clear layers. Legend says a Jin emperor read “osmanthus in autumn, lotus for ten li” and decided to invade the south — only a story, but it shows how seductive these lines are.
background: Liu Yong (c. 984–c. 1053) was the best-loved lyricist of the early Northern Song and a master of the long, slow lyric form (慢词). Tradition says he wrote this for Sun He, then the official in charge of Hangzhou, as a way of being introduced to him.
pronunciation: 参差 cēn cī；天堑 qiàn；珠玑 jī；豪奢 shē；重湖 chóng；叠巘 yǎn（山峰）；桂子 guì zǐ；菱歌 líng；钓叟 sǒu；千骑 jì（一人一马，不读 qí）；乘醉 chéng；图将 jiāng。
version: 采用统编教材（选择性必修下册）通行文本。“三吴都会”一作“江吴都会”；“嬉嬉钓叟莲娃”各本相同。另据《钱塘遗事》等本：“清嘉”一作“清佳”，“归去凤池夸”一作“归去凤城夸”，网站从教材本。

lines.zh: 东南形胜，三吴都会，钱塘自古繁华。
lines.rhythm: 东南/形胜，三吴/都会，钱塘/自古/繁华
lines.py: dōng nán xíng shèng, sān wú dū huì, qián táng zì gǔ fán huá
lines.lit: The finest site of the southeast, the great city of the Three Wu — Qiantang has been flourishing since ancient times.
lines.en: The jewel of the southeast, capital of the old Wu lands — Qiantang has thrived since time began.

lines.zh: 烟柳画桥，风帘翠幕，参差十万人家。
lines.rhythm: 烟柳/画桥，风帘/翠幕，参差/十万/人家
lines.py: yān liǔ huà qiáo, fēng lián cuì mù, cēn cī shí wàn rén jiā
lines.lit: Misty willows, painted bridges, wind-curtains, green drapes — uneven rows of a hundred thousand households.
lines.en: Willows like mist, painted bridges, curtains and green drapes stirring in the breeze, a hundred thousand homes rising high and low.

lines.zh: 云树绕堤沙，怒涛卷霜雪，天堑无涯。
lines.rhythm: 云树/绕/堤沙，怒涛/卷/霜雪，天堑/无涯
lines.py: yún shù rào dī shā, nù tāo juǎn shuāng xuě, tiān qiàn wú yá
lines.lit: Cloud-high trees circle the sandy dykes; angry waves roll up frost and snow; the natural moat has no shore.
lines.en: Towering trees line the sandy dykes; the raging tide flings up waves like frost and snow across a river with no far shore.

lines.zh: 市列珠玑，户盈罗绮，竞豪奢。
lines.rhythm: 市列/珠玑，户盈/罗绮，竞/豪奢
lines.py: shì liè zhū jī, hù yíng luó qǐ, jìng háo shē
lines.lit: Markets display pearls and gems; households are full of silks — vying in luxury.
lines.en: Markets glitter with pearls, homes overflow with silk, each outdoing the next in splendour.

lines.zh: 重湖叠巘清嘉，有三秋桂子，十里荷花。
lines.rhythm: 重湖/叠巘/清嘉，有/三秋/桂子，十里/荷花
lines.py: chóng hú dié yǎn qīng jiā, yǒu sān qiū guì zǐ, shí lǐ hé huā
lines.lit: Layered lakes and stacked peaks are clear and fine; there is osmanthus in autumn and lotus for ten li.
lines.en: Lake beyond lake, peak upon peak, clear and lovely — osmanthus in autumn, and lotus flowers for miles.
lines.tts: 虫湖叠眼清嘉，有三秋桂子，十里荷花。

lines.zh: 羌管弄晴，菱歌泛夜，嬉嬉钓叟莲娃。
lines.rhythm: 羌管/弄晴，菱歌/泛夜，嬉嬉/钓叟/莲娃
lines.py: qiāng guǎn nòng qíng, líng gē fàn yè, xī xī diào sǒu lián wá
lines.lit: Flutes play in the sunshine; water-chestnut songs float at night; merry are the old anglers and lotus girls.
lines.en: Flutes play under clear skies, picking songs drift over the night water, and old fishermen and lotus girls are all smiles.

lines.zh: 千骑拥高牙，乘醉听箫鼓，吟赏烟霞。
lines.rhythm: 千骑/拥/高牙，乘醉/听/箫鼓，吟赏/烟霞
lines.py: qiān jì yōng gāo yá, chéng zuì tīng xiāo gǔ, yín shǎng yān xiá
lines.lit: A thousand horsemen escort the tall banner; flushed with wine he listens to pipes and drums, chanting and admiring the mist and clouds.
lines.en: A thousand riders escort the governor’s banner; merry with wine, he hears pipes and drums and sings of the misty hills.
lines.tts: 千寄拥高牙，乘醉听箫鼓，吟赏烟霞。

lines.zh: 异日图将好景，归去凤池夸。
lines.rhythm: 异日/图将/好景，归去/凤池夸
lines.py: yì rì tú jiāng hǎo jǐng, guī qù fèng chí kuā
lines.lit: Another day, paint this fine scenery, and go back to the Phoenix Pool to boast.
lines.en: Someday you’ll paint this view and take it back to court to show it off.

words.en: a place with a fine, strategic setting
words.note: 地理位置优越、风景优美的地方。
现代汉语“参差不齐”；这里也有“大约”的意思。

words.en: a natural moat — here the wide Qiantang River
words.note: 堑：护城河。今天还说“天堑变通途”。
今天还说“字字珠玑”，比喻文章好。
三秋：秋季（或指农历九月）；桂子：桂花。杭州至今以桂花闻名。
骑：一人一马，这里读 jì；今天作动词读 qí。

words.en: the tall banner of a high official
mist and coloured clouds — beautiful scenery

imagery.name: 柳
imagery.zh: 如烟的柳树和画桥组成江南城市最典型的画面。
imagery.en: Misty willows by painted bridges make the classic picture of a southern Chinese city.

imagery.name: 西湖
imagery.zh: “重湖叠巘”写西湖湖山层叠，是杭州之美的中心。
imagery.en: “Lake beyond lake, peak upon peak” is West Lake, the heart of Hangzhou’s beauty.

imagery.name: 桂
imagery.zh: 秋天满城桂花飘香，代表杭州的富庶与美好。
imagery.en: Osmanthus scenting the city in autumn stands for Hangzhou’s richness and charm.

imagery.name: 莲
imagery.zh: “十里荷花”写夏日西湖，和桂花一起成为杭州的名片。
imagery.en: “Lotus for ten li” is West Lake in summer — with osmanthus, the city’s calling card.
